result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I haven't added a test for the new behavior. The `Landscape*` tests in `codeanalyzer` ran clean.

The change is one added condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. A contributor matched by no team goes into the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true.

Dormant unmatched contributors are left out. Blank latest-commit dates count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for blank dates. Configured teams are untouched and keep all their members.
